question: An individual who refrains from every kind of pleasure or self-gratification.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ascetic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ascetic"** refers to a person who practices severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons. (संयासी)

 
 
• **Example:** The monk lived an ascetic life, dedicating himself to meditation and prayer while avoiding all worldly pleasures.
 
 
 
• An **"Ascetic"** is characterized by a lifestyle of simplicity and often involves the renunciation of material possessions and sensory pleasures. (त्यागी)
 
 
• **Example:** His ascetic lifestyle was driven by his desire for spiritual enlightenment.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ascetic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Misogynist** (स्त्रीद्वेषी): A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.

 
 
• **Example:** His comments about women made him sound like a misogynist.
 
 
 
• **Mythical** (पौराणिक): Something that exists only in myths or folklore; not real.
 
 
• **Example:** The story of the phoenix is a well-known mythical tale.
 
 
 
• **Sceptical** (संदेहवादी): Having doubts or reservations about something; not easily convinced.
 
 
• **Example:** She was sceptical about the success of the new business plan.
